On Friday, May 22 at 10:15 p.m. ET, a three-game series between the San Francisco Giants and the Chicago White Sox will begin.

San Francisco has been the underdog in 32 games this season and won 13 (40.6%) of those contests. The White Sox have put together a 1-3 record in games they were listed as the moneyline favorite (winning 25% of those games). This season, Chicago has been the underdog 41 times and won 22, or 53.7%, of those games.
